text:
michael: :rotating_light: paging eng-sre oncall — sudden increase in 5xx and timeouts hitting the inference gateway after the 12:03 deploy to prod. p95 jumped from ~320ms to 1.8s, p99 to >4s, and we’re seeing a bunch of Gateway Timeout 504s. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/r/prod-inference-latency
incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0314-01. Severity: high. Paging oncall team.
sara: on it. grabbing logs and traces now. any customer reports?
customer-success: just got two support tickets about timeouts, one enterprise customer report of errors in the connector. passing to account team.
ops-bot: deploy-bot reports: rollout v3.14.27 started at 12:03:21, finished canary at 12:05:10, full rollout at 12:12:08. No immediate errors during canary.
lina: throwing up traces — high queue latency in the gateway process, worker threads saturating, redis KV cache latency looks normal. suspect batching or a change in request serialization from the new runtime variant.
julian: saw increased backend CPU on model-serving hosts at 12:13. One host hitting 98% CPU. logs show a lot of "input_chunk_size exceeded" warnings from the runtime.
michael: @lina can you confirm whether the new runtime changed batch sizing heuristics?
lina: yes — v3.14.27 enabled adaptive_batching=true by default and bumped max_batch_tokens to 8192. That could cause larger batches to pile up and spike latency on tail.
sara: can we flip adaptive_batching off or rollback config? how fast to mitigate?
julian: we can hotfix the config in the routing service to force batch_size_limit=256. rolling a config patch now: `kubectl set env deployment/gateway BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=256 --namespace=prod`
ops-bot: executing: kubectl patch deployment gateway -n prod ... (started)
incidents-bot: @michael, @sara — engage on-call handoff if you need extra eyes.
michael: sara, julian — coord on the patch. lina, watch metrics. I'll update exec to CS for impacted customers.
sara: patch applied. diff: `BATCH_MAX_TOKENS: 8192 -> 256`
julian: gateway pods restarting now (rolling restart).
lina: seeing queue length drop on gateway, p95 improving to ~450ms within 30s. p99 still high but trending down.
michael: good. any 5xx still?
sara: 5xx rate dropped by 70% after restart, timeouts down. still some 504s for long tails.
customer-success: telling affected customers we’re mitigating, ETA for full recovery 10-15m.
julian: quick note: one model-serving host didn’t drain properly and had a stuck KV-cache flush loop. killing the process cleared it, CPU back to normal.
lina: removing that host from LB temporarily, rebalancing.
incidents-bot: Incident status: Mitigating — partial recovery observed.
michael: do we need immediate rollback of v3.14.27 or is hotfix good enough? risks with rollback?
sara: rollback would revert adaptive_batching default and related runtime changes; risk is small but involves a full redeploy and potential short blip. hotfix looks stable and faster. prefer hotfix + continued monitoring.
julian: agree. keeping rollback on standby if we see a regression in next 15m.
lina: alerting on p99 > 2s and gateway_5xx_rate > 0.5% with paging to oncall.
michael: noted. commencing customer impact call in 5. @customer-success, please compile affected accounts list.
customer-success: compiling now — sending list to #incidents-private.
ops-bot: metrics: request_rate steady, p95 ~380ms, p99 ~1.4s, 5xx rate 0.12%. Errors trending to baseline.
sara: no new deploys for prod for 30m. lock set: prod-deploys:LOCK by eng-sre.
michael: thanks team. leaving oncall to monitor — @sara @lina keep me posted.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-0314-01 moved to: Monitoring.
julian: followup note for postmortem — include batch default change, canary test coverage didn't include high-concurrency tail-of-day workload. need synthetic load test for p99 scenarios.
lina: logging action: capture a 5-min flamegraph and enable debug on batch selection path for next rollout.
michael: good. will schedule a quick root-cause call 16:00 UTC and assign owners. Sending summary to execs.
customer-success: customers notified: two support tickets resolved (timeout mitigated), one enterprise has a short outage window logged. will follow-up for SLA credits if requested.
sara: closing thread once all alerts clear and postmortem ticket created.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-0314-01 resolved -> Monitoring -> Post-Incident Review scheduled.
michael: resolved for now. thanks everyone. :tada:
